# `create_object`

Create a new ABAP object. Supported types: PROG, CLAS, INTF, FUGR, DEVC, DOMA (domain), DTEL (data element), TABL (table), STRUCT (structure), DDLS (CDS DDL), DCLS (CDS DCL), BDEF (RAP behavior definition), SRVD (RAP service definition).

Defined in [`packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/create-object.ts`](https://github.com/abapify/adt-cli/blob/main/packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/create-object.ts).

## Input schema

| Parameter     | Type     | Required         | Description                                                                                                          |
| ------------- | -------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `baseUrl`     | `string` | no               | SAP system base URL (e.g. https://host:8000) Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                                                |
| `client`      | `string` | no               | SAP client number Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                                                                           |
| `username`    | `string` | no               | Username for basic auth Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                                                                     |
| `password`    | `string` | no               | Password for basic auth Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                                                                     |
| `systemId`    | `string` | no               | Logical system id (resolved via the server multi-system configuration) Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                      |
| `objectName`  | `string` | yes              | Name of the new object (uppercase, e.g. ZCL_MY_CLASS, ZPACKAGE) Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                             |
| `objectType`  | `string` | yes              | Object type: PROG, CLAS, INTF, FUGR, DEVC, DOMA, DTEL, TABL, STRUCT, DDLS, DCLS, BDEF, SRVD Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞. |
| `description` | `string` | yes              | Short description of the object Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                                                             |
| `packageName` | `string` | no               | Package to assign the object to (required for non-local objects) Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                            |
| `transport`   | `string` | no               | Transport request number (required for transportable objects) Length: 0–∞. Items: 0–∞.                               |
| `destination` | `string` | destination mode | Required when the server runs in destination mode; an ADT destination key matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]\{1,62\}$`.       |

_In destination mode every call additionally requires a `destination` key and rejects the connection fields (`baseUrl`, `client`, `username`, `password`, `systemId`)._

## Output

The tool returns a single text content item whose body is a JSON-serialised object (`content[0].text`). On error, the response has `isError: true` and a human-readable message.

```json
{
  "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "<JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)>" }]
}
```

See the source for the exact shape of `result`.

## Example invocation

```json
{
  "name": "create_object",
  "arguments": {
    "baseUrl": "https://sap.example.com:44300",
    "username": "DEVELOPER",
    "password": "***",
    "client": "100",
    "objectName": "<objectName>",
    "objectType": "<objectType>",
    "description": "<description>"
  }
}
```
